app.name: SQL Client
app.description: Query approved databases with read-only defaults.

sql.scope: An administrator saves connections in App Store → Catalog sources → Databases for apps. Credentials stay on the server; this app never receives passwords.
sql.permission: Database access is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check app permissions and connection access.
sql.schemaTruncated: The schema list is limited to 2,000 tables and views.
sql.paramsHint: Use $1, $2… for PostgreSQL or ? for MySQL. Up to 100 text, number, boolean or null parameters; parameters are never saved.
sql.allowWrite: Request a write for this query
sql.writeHint: Read only by default. EveryOS separately asks you to approve each write statement. Changes may be irreversible.
sql.invalid: Enter one SQL statement of up to 100,000 characters and a JSON array of at most 100 scalar parameters.
sql.truncated: Result limited by the requested rows or server byte/cell limits. CSV contains only the returned snapshot.
sql.historyHint: The last 30 successful statements stay only in this window. Query text, parameters and results are never persisted. Replaying history resets write authorization and parameters.
sql.readOnlyError: This statement was refused in read-only mode. Use a writable connection and explicitly request a write if you intend to change data.
sql.busyError: The database operation limit was reached. Wait for current work to finish and retry.
